poems.line: Steen Steensen Blicher, Trækfuglene, Trækfuglene (1838): 'Sig nærmer Tiden' (Præludium), 'Hjejlen' and 'Lærken', in the old spelling, as transcribed on Danish Wikisource (1838)

Steen Steensen Blicher, Sange (songs and dialect songs), Songs of Blicher as printed in the 19th century and transcribed on Danish Wikisource: 'Mads Doss', 'Jyden han æ stærk å sej' and 'Gojawten' in Jutland dialect spelling, 'Til glæden' in its original version (1825)
